name: Exterior Porch Floor RP Finish Coat
intent: RP finish — porch enamel by method. Cut-in LF-based. Coat 2 rates faster than coat 1 (sealed aggregate base). Step detail. Same QT-to-product mapping as NC.
doctrine: RP finish coat 1. Porch enamel universal RP product. Cut-in LF-based at 80 LF/hr. Roll 250 SF/hr, spray_backroll 450 SF/hr (2-crew). Steps brush 4 EA/hr with alternating-step pattern and anti-slip aggregate on treads.
